title: 心理科学専門実験・演習Ｂ
subtitle: Psychological Science Major Lab/Exercises B
educationalGoal:
Design and execution of behavioral experimentt: Students practice writing a program for a psychological experiment using MATLAB and PsychToolBox, run the experiment, and perform analysis of variance with the data obtained in the experiment.
Measurement of Brain Activity and Biological Information: Students practice measuring brain activity and biological information with different measurement devices, and analyze the data.
advice: In order to reveal the system for processing on cognition, it is necessary to measure and analyze not only overt behavioral indices, but also implicit ones like brain and biological activity. In “Design and execution of behavioral experiment”, students practice writing a program for a experiment on cognitive psychology using MATLAB and PsychToolBox. In “Measurement of Brain Activity and Biological Information”, students practice experiments to measure brain activity and biological information. Both components include not only experiments, but presentations and writing reports on the experiments. Understanding these methods is important to understand the system for processing on Kansei and cognition, and to prepare for experiments in Design Project III.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In order to reveal the system for processing on cognition, it is necessary to measure and analyze not only overt behavioral indices, but also implicit ones like brain and biological activity. In “Design and execution of behavioral experiment”, students practice writing a program for a experiment on cognitive psychology using MATLAB and PsychToolBox. In “Measurement of Brain Activity and Biological Information”, students practice experiments to measure brain activity and biological information. Both components include not only experiments, but presentations and writing reports on the experiments. Understanding these methods is important to understand the system for processing on Kansei and cognition, and to prepare for experiments in Design Project III.
